params.caption: 🎮 Star Wars: Galactic Racer is adding split-screen in 2027 Developer Fuse Games says its arcade podracing game will get local split-screen multiplayer next year, answering one of the loudest requests from players. A new game mode is also on the way in the same 2027 update. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 22:38 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @starwars 🛋️ Couch racing is back!
